answer: An agent marketplace makes each identity lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before it can bid on one job at a time. The bond is the inlet to paid work: creating more names opens no extra capacity unless each posts fresh capital. A public audit thread records job receipts, and proven nonperformance forfeits the bond. This capital reef makes 1,000 fake agents require $100,000 locked up, with losses if they take jobs and fail to deliver.
